284050834.description:
Wood Tobacco Smoking Pipe
Smooth Briar Finish with Straight Stem
Wood and Vulcanite, 5 Inches
This classic estate tobacco pipe features a smooth wooden bowl with warm graining paired with a straight dark stem. Traditional wooden smoking pipes of this design offer enduring appeal for collectors of tobacciana and enthusiasts. Its balanced proportions and round bowl make it an iconic example of classic pipe design.
Turned wooden bowl with rich reddish-brown finish and visible grain
Classic straight stem with tapered mouthpiece
Round tobacco chamber showing cake from prior use
Measures approximately 5 inches in length
Condition:
Estate pre-owned condition. The wooden bowl shows minor surface wear, small nicks, and natural handling patina. Chamber rim exhibits charring and inner carbon cake from prior smoking. Stem displays light surface oxidation and minor tooth marks near the lip. Structurally sound with no cracks observed.

Crystal & Mineral Specimen Lot - 15 Pieces
Natural Geological Specimens & Polished Stones
This diverse collection includes fifteen natural crystal and mineral specimens showcasing a variety of geological formations, colors, and textures. Hollow geode half with sparkling crystalline druzy cavity
Tumbled smooth pink rose quartz stone
Polished triangular red-orange carnelian or jasper stone
Rounded tumbled pink quartz pebble
Rough purple amethyst crystal fragment
Dark purple rough mineral specimen
Sparkling green mineral specimen with mica-like luster
Glossy black obsidian shard specimen
Rough red jasper stone with natural matrix
Metallic pyrite mineral cluster specimen
Brown mineral rock with metallic inclusions
Rough layered dark mineral specimen
Rough smoky quartz crystal point specimen
Translucent frosted flat mineral slab
Rough mottled green and white stone specimen
Condition:
All specimens are intact natural rocks and polished stones. Natural variations, raw cleavage edges, inclusions, and surface fractures are inherent to each geological piece. Polished stones retain smooth surfaces.
